known_bugs: Using the riddle scroll (item 28) re-shows riddle 1's picture (frame 1082) when riddle 2 was drawn (FUN_0001b0a4 uses 0x43a twice); the riddle man himself shows the right one (0x43b).

Riddle answers: option 0 is never accepted - the check is `choice == 1 and riddle < 2` or `choice == 2 and riddle == 2`, which matches the intended answers 14 / 19 / 97 only because of the option order.
